theater: 陝西麟州屈野河斷道塢

battle.name: 斷塢道之戰
battle.theater: 陝西麟州屈野河斷道塢
battle.brief: 嘉祐二年五月，西夏攝政沒藏訹龐屯兵屈野河，宋麟州知州武戡、管勾軍事郭恩未報朝廷即築堡，夜進忽里堆，遭夏軍自南北合圍於斷道塢，宋軍潰敗，郭恩與黃道元被俘。事後龐籍遭御史彈劾貶官，宋廷改以禁絕和市回應，屈野河劃界糾紛延至1062年六月協議方告平息。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 交戰的兩方是西夏與宋朝。西夏是黨項羌人建立的夏國，都城興慶府，國主為毅宗李諒祚；1048年李元昊病逝時李諒祚尚在衝齡，國舅沒藏訹龐以攝政身份總攬軍政，邊境上每一次出兵、驅農與挑釁都由他一手安排。西夏在陝北的兵力由宥州、麟州兩方向的部署與各部落的蕃兵拼成，沒藏訹龐自領主力屯於屈野河一帶，兵數增至數萬，並徵發麟州以北百姓的耕牛與農具。宋方是北宋朝廷，陝西與河東兩路邊防分由兩個經略安撫使司管轄，陝西一路領秦鳳、涇原、永興軍路，河東一路領并州、麟州、府州；知麟州者為武戡，設通判夏倚判署州事，管勾軍事郭恩掌屯戍與調兵，河東經略使兼知并州龐籍總攏北線，司馬光時任并州通判，奉命經理夏人侵耕之事；京師樞密院掌調兵之權，端明殿學士王素出任渭州知州，御史臺則負責彈劾邊帥。這不是兩國主力之間的會戰，而是邊軍、堡寨、遊騎與臨時徵發的蕃部武裝在數百里邊牆上的消耗。
countriesEn: The two sides were Western Xia and the Song. Western Xia was the state founded by the Tangut Qiang, with its capital at Xingqing and its ruler the Emperor Yizong Li Liangzuo; when Li Yuanhao died suddenly in 1048 the boy on the throne was a child, and the consort of the late ruler Mozang Epang took charge of military and civil affairs as regent, and every sortie, every pushing of peasants over the line and every provocation on the frontier was arranged by his own hand. The Xia strength in the northern Shaanxi border was put together from the garrisons of the Youshou and Linzhou lines and from the tribal levies of the various clans; Mozang Epang led the main body himself, massed along the Quye river, where the numbers had grown to several tens of thousands, and the ploughing oxen and farm tools of the people north of Linzhou were requisitioned. On the Song side was the Northern Song court, and the frontier in Shaanxi and in Hedong was administered by two separate pacification commissions, the Shaanxi one covering the Qinfeng, Jingyuan and Yongxing circuits and the Hedong one covering Bingzhou, Linzhou and Fuzhou. Linzhou was governed by Wu Kan, with an assistant prefect, Xia Yi, signing the prefects orders, and the officer for military works and troop movements, Guo En, in charge of the garrison; the pacification commissioner for Hedong, who was also governor of Bingzhou, Pang Ji, held the whole northern line, while Sima Guang, then assistant prefect of Bingzhou, had been sent out to manage the Xia encroachment. In the capital the Bureau of War kept the power of moving troops, the learned scholar of the Hall of the Wishing Candles Wang Su was appointed governor of Weizhou, and the Censorate was the arm that impeached the frontier commanders. This was not a set-piece battle between the main armies of two states; it was a grinding of frontier garrisons, forts, raiding parties and hastily levied tribal irregulars along several hundred li of frontier wall.
people: 推動此役的關鍵人物分屬兩方，且多數不是以武勇取勝而是以權責釀成敗局。西夏方面是國舅沒藏訹龐，實際執政者；他殺死李元昊的遺孀之後再無顧忌，屢次驅農越界、縱兵劫掠，待宋廷驅逐夏民、掠其境內畜產，便秘密在邊境集兵報復。宋方的核心是河東經略使兼知并州龐籍，築堡之議由他拍板定奪，卻未及報請朝廷，兵敗後御史據此彈劾他引惹邊事；他在被追問時為保全司馬光，於繳交文書中刪去司馬光參與決策的字樣，把責任一人擔下，最終在嘉祐二年十一月被貶為青州知州。司馬光時任并州通判，是他最先提出在麟州州西增築二堡，理由是敵來耕則驅之、已種則蹂踐之、敵眾盛則入堡以避，若堡成則州西五十里內可無患；他聽從了這個意見，回并州向龐籍詳報並獲認可，事後卻自慚其事，四處向公卿大夫解釋前日之敗蓋由邊將輕敵無備、本非作堡之過，連續上書自請處分，朝廷駁回其請。實戰層面，麟州知州武戡與通判夏倚議定築堡，管勾軍事郭恩奉命勘察並率軍築堡，途中得斥候報夏軍大集於沙鼠浪，力主停止前進，卻被隨軍的走馬承奉、內侍黃道元否決，兵敗後郭恩自盡，黃道元與兵馬監押劉慶被俘，武戡得脫。遠在渭州的新任知州王素、奉命巡檢的殿直張安世與賈恩、幾番出使的殿中丞孫兆、1061年接任河東經略使的梁適，以及1062年代表宋方劃界的代州鈴轄蘇安靜，都是這條邊界上的相關人物。
peopleEn: The decisive figures belong to both sides, and most of them did not lose or win by valour but through the handling of authority and responsibility. On the Xia side stands Mozang Epang, the consort of the late ruler and the man who actually governed; after putting the Xia dowager to death he had nothing left to fear, and he drove the peasants over the line again and again and sent his horsemen to plunder, and when the Song drove out the Xia people and carried off their livestock he gathered troops secretly along the border to take revenge. At the centre of the Song side was Pang Ji, pacification commissioner for Hedong and governor of Bingzhou. The decision to build the forts was his, it was taken without reference to the court, and when the army was beaten the Censorate impeached him on the ground that he had provoked the fighting on the frontier. Under examination he removed from the papers he handed in every trace of Sima Guangs part in the decision, so as to protect him, and took the whole responsibility himself; in the eleventh month of the second year of Jiayou he was finally demoted to governor of Qingzhou. Sima Guang, then assistant prefect of Bingzhou, was the one who first proposed putting up two extra forts about twenty li west of the state city of Linzhou, on the reasoning that if the enemy came to till they should be driven off, that what had been sown should be trampled under, that if the enemy came in strength they should shelter inside the fort, and that once the fort stood there would be no trouble for fifty li west of the state; he approved the plan, rode back to Bingzhou and reported it in full to Pang Ji and gained his assent, and afterwards he was deeply ashamed of it, going about among the ministers and high officers to explain that the defeat of the other day was due to the frontier commanders being light in enemy and unprepared, and in no way to the building of the fort, and he petitioned the throne again and again to have himself punished; the court refused his request. At the level of the fighting, the governor of Linzhou Wu Kan and the assistant prefect Xia Yi settled on the building of the fort, and the officer for military works Guo En was sent to survey the site and led the working party. When his scouts reported that the Xia army had massed in large numbers at Shalonglang, Guo En urged that the advance be halted, but the trotting courier of the imperial service, the palace attendant Huang Daoyuan, refused, and after the defeat Guo En killed himself, Huang Daoyuan and the inspector of the cavalry Liu Qing were taken prisoner, and Wu Kan got away. Elsewhere, the newly appointed governor of Weizhou Wang Su, the palace officers Zhang Anshi and Jia En sent out to patrol, the palace official Sun Zhao who was twice sent across to negotiate, Liang Shi who took over the Hedong command in 1061, and Su Anjing, the Suzhou officer who drew the boundary for the Song in 1062, are all figures belonging to this stretch of the frontier.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是希臘火：裝在銅管與虹吸管中的燃燒劑，靠壓力把混有松脂的燃油噴出並點燃，配方是拜占庭帝國的國家機密，配方隨載有它的船隻一同沉入海底，此後再無成船流傳。斷道塢一役的戰場上並沒有這件兵器，當時宋夏之間也沒有海戰，希臘火在此只是這一族燃燒武器的標本。但它有直接的同類：北宋《武經總要》所記的猛火油櫃，以皮囊盛油、以唧筒噴射點火，所用是礦物油而非植物油，噴射原理與希臘火的銅管如出一轍，該書成書於1044年，比本戰役早十三年；唐宋以來火油與火箭已是西北邊防的常備火攻器材，可以焚燒草棚、燒絕道路、破壞塹壘上的柴柵。真正投入此役的裝備，兩邊各有其物。宋軍出動步騎一千四百餘，其中約半數未著甲，裝備以弓弩、長槍與短兵為主，另備築堡用的版築工具、木柵與掘壕的鐐鍬，糧秣自并州、麟州後方供應，夜行靠人馬自攜數日之糧。西夏軍是一支純粹的騎兵集團，徵發來的耕牛與農具隨行，以馬匹馱載帳幕、箭壺與食糧；其戰時補給不靠後方輜重車隊，而靠游騎在邊境劫掠與巡耕，就地取給。堡寨所用的版築與封堠標記，是宋人在這條邊界上少數真正新造的東西，也是此役雙方真正爭奪的标的。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is Greek fire: a burning charge set in copper tubes and siphons, which threw out a fuel mixed with resin and set it alight under pressure; the formula was a state secret of the Byzantine Empire, and it sank with the ships that carried it, so that it was never afterwards transmitted in a vessel that survived. Greek fire was not present on the field at Duandaowu, and there was no sea fighting between the Song and the Xia in those days, so here the card is only a specimen of the family of burning weapons. It does however have a direct kinsman: the fierce-oil chest described in the Wujing Zongyao of the Northern Song, which carried oil in a leather bag and fired it by means of a pump, using mineral oil and not vegetable oil, so that the principle of the jet was exactly that of the copper tube of the Greek fire; the book was completed in 1044, thirteen years before this battle. From Tang and Song times onward the fire oil and the fire arrow had been standing equipment of the north-western frontier, good for burning huts, cutting roads and breaking the brushwood along a ditch. The material actually used in this engagement was of two kinds, one on each side. The Song took into the field more than 1400 foot and horse, about half of them without armour, equipped chiefly with bows, crossbows, long spears and short weapons, and with the tools of the moulding parties, the brushwood and the picks for the ditch, their grain coming from the rear at Bingzhou and Linzhou, a few days supply carried by the men and horses on the night march. The Xia army was purely a body of horsemen, the requisitioned ploughing oxen and farm tools travelling with them and the tents, the quivers and the food carried on horseback; their supply in war did not rest on a train of baggage waggons from the rear but on raiding parties and on the ploughing tours that took what the border offered. The moulded ramparts and the marked boundary posts were among the few things the Song genuinely built new on this frontier, and they were the real object of contention in the battle.
tactics: 宋方的戰術是築堡偵守，程序卻在出發第一步就走錯。依司馬光之議，堡寨應築在麟州州西約二十里處，用以耳目、藩蔽，並非遠征；管勾軍事郭恩奉命勘察並督役築堡，先遣斥候偵察，報稱夏軍正大集於沙鼠浪。郭恩當即主張停止前進，內侍黃道元不從，於是率步騎一千四百餘人趁夜色沿屈野河北上，抵達臥牛峰時遠處夏軍已點烽火、擂戰鼓示警，黃道元仍不置信，堅持行進。至天明，宋軍抵忽里堆，見數十夏騎往西奔馳，至距宋軍數十步處停住，既不應聲也不移動；隨後火光四起，沒藏訹龐遣軍張開左右兩翼，自南北兩個方向合圍過來。忽里堆東面有一道深溝，溝中一道土梁名斷道塢，宋軍遂據斷道塢死守，奮力抵抗；戰至多時，夏軍自忽里堆東面長塹兩側攀登上來，四面合擊，宋軍陣腳一散而不可收拾，多數被殺被俘，軍械盡失。戰術上的三處破綻都寫在這一夜：一是斥候情報已到而未被採納，進退之權操於內侍與走馬承奉之手，邊將反不能止；二是堡未築成即貿然深入百里，將主力送到夏人預設的合圍圈中；三是出動兵力僅一千四百餘，半數無甲，縱有工事亦難久支。戰後宋廷不再用兵，改以禁絕和市、封堠劃界的經濟與外交手段收束戰線，兩界的巡捉人馬並被限定不得帶衣甲器械超過三十人騎。
tacticsEn: The Song plan was to build forts and to watch, and yet at the first step the procedure went wrong. On the plan of Sima Guang the forts were to be raised about twenty li west of the state city of Linzhou, to serve as eyes and ears and as a screen; it was no expedition. The officer for military works, Guo En, was sent to survey the site and to supervise the work, and sent out scouts first, who reported that the Xia army had massed in great numbers at Shalonglang. Guo En at once proposed to halt, the palace attendant Huang Daoyuan would not have it, and so he led more than 1400 foot and horse up the Quye river by night; when they reached Wolniu Peak the Xia had already lit beacons and beaten their drums in warning, and Huang Daoyuan still would not believe it and pressed on. At daybreak the Song reached Hulidui and saw several dozen Xia horsemen riding west, who pulled up at a few dozen paces from the Song, neither answering nor moving; then fires flared in every direction, and Mozang Epang sent his troops out to open the wings to left and right and close in from the north and from the south. On the east of Hulidui lay a deep ditch, and in the ditch a ridge of earth called the Duandaowu, and there the Song took their stand and fought hard; after a while the Xia climbed up on both sides of the long trench east of Hulidui, closed in from four sides, and the Song line broke at once and could not be gathered again, most of the men being killed or taken and the military equipment lost entire. Three tactical faults are written into that night. First, the intelligence from the scouts had come in and was not acted on, the power of advance and retreat lay with a palace attendant and a courier of the imperial service, and the frontier officer could not stop it. Second, the fort was not yet finished and the force marched boldly forward with the result of delivering the main body into the ring the Xia had prepared. Third, only some 1400 men were engaged and half of them had no armour, so that even a good work could not be held long. After the defeat the Song used no more troops: they closed the line with the economic and diplomatic measures of stopping the markets, fixing boundary posts and drawing the border, and the patrol parties of the two sides were limited to no more than thirty riders carrying no arms and no armour.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。交戰時間為宋仁宗嘉祐二年五月、西夏毅宗奲都元年，即1057年5月，地點在屈野河畔的斷道塢與忽里堆，今陝西省神木市一帶，舊麟州城以西。戰前沒藏訹龐在屈野河一帶屯兵，至三月間兵力增至數萬，並徵發麟州以北百姓的所有耕牛與農具。宋軍出動的築堡大軍為步騎一千四百餘名，其中約半數沒有穿戴鎧甲。出戰的具體區段是麟州州西約二十里處擬增築的二堡，此前屈野河以西直抵界首五六十里並無堡障斥堠，夏人游騎往往直抵城下，甚至越過城東。戰果：郭恩、黃道元、兵馬監押劉慶被俘，郭恩自盡身亡，武戡脫身；宋軍戰死三百八十七人，喪失兵甲器械合計一萬七千餘件，記為喪兵矢甲一萬七千餘。戰後處置：嘉祐二年十一月，龐籍被貶為青州知州，司馬光自請處分被朝廷駁回。往後的交涉中，孫兆按慶歷舊例提出以橫陽河為府州界、三分許一分給夏國，因當時夏人侵界六十里，此議只令退兵四十里。1061年毅宗李諒祚誅除沒藏訹龐、開始親政，1062年六月雙方定界，約定兩界巡捉人員各不得帶衣甲器械過三十人騎，和市違約即罷。禁絕市易之後，陝西沿邊一絹之直數千，官民怨聲載道。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The fighting took place in the fifth month of the second year of Jiayou of Emperor Renzong of the Song, the first year of Dedu of Emperor Yizong of Xia, that is May of 1057, at the Duandaowu and the Hulidui on the Quye river, in what is now the city of Shenmu in Shaanxi, west of the old walled town of Linzhou. Before the battle Mozang Epang had his troops massed along the Quye river, the numbers there had grown to tens of thousands by the third month, and all the ploughing oxen and farm tools of the people north of Linzhou had been requisitioned. The working party that the Song sent out to build the fort numbered more than 1400 foot and horse, about half of them without armour. The section being fortified was about twenty li west of the state city of Linzhou, where two extra forts were to be raised; up to that time there had been no fort or watch-post at all for fifty or sixty li from the Quye river westward to the boundary mark, and Xia raiding parties often came right up to the walls, and even past the east of the city. As for the result: Guo En, Huang Daoyuan and the inspector of the cavalry Liu Qing were taken prisoner, Guo En killed himself, and Wu Kan escaped. Three hundred and eighty-seven Song soldiers were killed, and the arms and armour lost came to seventeen thousand odd pieces, recorded as the loss of seventeen thousand odd soldiers weapons and armour. After the action: in the eleventh month of the second year of Jiayou Pang Ji was demoted to governor of Qingzhou, and the court refused the request Sima Guang made to be punished. In the later negotiations Sun Zhao proposed, following the precedent of the Qingli years, that the Hengyang river should be the boundary between Fuzhou and Xia, one part in three being given to the Xia; since the Xia had then encroached sixty li, this arrangement made them give back only forty li. In 1061 the emperor Yizong Li Liangzuo put Mozang Epang to death and began to govern in his own person, and in June 1062 the two sides fixed the border, agreeing that the patrol parties of each side should not take more than thirty riders, and no arms or armour at that, and that the markets would be stopped if the terms were broken. After the markets were stopped, a bolt of silk in the Shaanxi border markets was worth several thousand, and the people of both sides complained bitterly.
cause: 起因是西夏攝政沒藏訹龐與宋邊吏在屈野河一線的長期侵耕糾紛。1048年李元昊突然病逝，衝齡的李諒祚繼位，國舅沒藏訹龐總攬朝政，殺死掌政的遺孀後更加肆無忌憚。1053年他以索要古渭州為名向宋發難，攻入德順軍、圍攻靜邊，兵鋒直指吐蕃邊緣的秦州三百里外，迫使宋廷改派王素出任渭州知州，涇原一線蕃漢數萬人夾道歡迎，夏軍才撤退。此後沒藏訹龐一面縱兵在邊境劫掠，一面煽動西夏邊民越境侵耕宋土，而當時宋邊吏只求歲滿得遷官，多不願過問，宋廷雖於1055年派張安世等巡檢、與龐籍聯名向宥州發公文詰責，又令西夏歸還侵耕田土，但使者李守貴隨即被殺，問責無疾而終。1057年，司馬光到麟州與武戡、夏倚議定築二堡以驅逐夏人游騎，龐籍未待報批即令興工，沒藏訹龐乘宋廷驅民、掠境之際暗中集兵，雙方在一處斷續兩年的地界爭端中，終於把零星的界碑纠纷變成一場兵禍。根本的病灶在體制：宋廷無法同時處理築堡即侵地、驅農即挑釁這兩種指控，邊將於是各自尋求最方便的辦法，一方築堡、一方報復，把外交僵局推給前線的士兵去解決。
causeEn: The cause was a long quarrel over encroachment and cultivation along the Quye river between the Xia regent Mozang Epang and the Song frontier officials. When Li Yuanhao died suddenly in 1048 the child Li Liangzuo succeeded him, and Mozang Epang, the consort of the late ruler, took charge of the government, and after killing the dowager who had held the reins he became utterly unconstrained. In 1053 he used the demand for the old prefecture of Guwei as a pretext to strike at the Song, breaking into Deshun Army and besieging Jingbian, his spearhead pointing toward the prefecture of Qin three hundred li away on the Tibetan border, which forced the Song court to send Wang Su to be governor of Weizhou, where tens of thousands of Tibetan and Chinese people of the Jingyuan area came out to welcome him, and only then did the Xia army withdraw. After that Mozang Epang on the one hand sent his horsemen to plunder along the border and on the other stirred the Xia border peasants to till Song soil across the line, while the Song frontier officials, concerned only with reaching the end of their term in office and being promoted, were unwilling to take the matter up; although in 1055 the court sent Zhang Anshi and others to patrol, and they joined with Pang Ji in sending a document of remonstrance to the Youshou, and the Xia dowager ordered the encroached fields to be given back, the envoy Li Shougui was killed soon afterwards and the question died with him. In 1057 Sima Guang reached Linzhou and settled with Wu Kan and Xia Yi that two forts would be built to drive off the Xia raiders, and Pang Ji, without waiting for the answer of the court, ordered the work to begin. Mozang Epang took advantage of the Song expulsion of his people and the carrying off of their livestock, and gathered his troops in secret, and so a two-year-old dispute over boundary markers was turned at last into a war of soldiers. The root of the sickness lay in the system: the court could not handle at the same time the two accusations that building a fort was encroaching and that driving off the farmers was a provocation, so the frontier officers on both sides each reached for the handiest expedient, one side built forts and the other took revenge, and a diplomatic stalemate was handed over to the soldiers in the field to settle.
impact: 此役是宋夏邊防史上少數幾次由宋軍在麟州方向慘敗的戰鬥，後果不限于一場敗仗。制度上，築堡未經樞密與朝廷批准即興工、進退之權被內侍與走馬承奉奪去、邊軍半數無甲而貿然深入，這三件事被御史合稱引惹邊事，龐籍貶為青州知州，司馬光雖得寬免卻自慚其咎，朝中由此形成一種對邊帥慎用兵器的風氣，麟州一線此後數年只守不攻。經濟上，宋廷在軟硬皆無效之後，只能沿用傳統的經濟制裁：懸榜禁絕陝西沿邊和市，沒藏訹龐亦反手禁止西人沿邊私糴民穀，蕃部屬戶犯禁者斬於犯處、妻子編管淮南，兩界市價因之一絹之直數千，官民怨聲載道，西夏的牧業與農業經濟都受到重創，這是宋夏之間少數真正奏效的武器。國際關係上，這場小小的邊寨之敗，最終倒逼出1061年毅宗誅除沒藏訹龐、1062年六月兩國訂立封堠與巡捉條款的正式劃界，自1055年起的屈野河糾紛至此了結，兩界巡捉人馬不得過三十人騎的限制，直到今日仍是宋夏邊界文書中的標準用語。技術上，這一戰把當時西北邊防的真實短板擺到檯面：以版築築起來的堡寨是宋人最拿得出手的工事，卻仍敵不過騎兵集團在漫長視野上的包抄；而卡面上那件銅管燃燒器所代表的火攻武器族，在這條邊界上從未成為決定勝負的因素。
impactEn: This engagement was one of the few occasions in the frontier history of the Song against the Xia when the Song suffered a bad defeat in the Linzhou direction, and its consequences went beyond the losing of one battle. In institutional terms, the building of the fort without the approval of the Bureau of War and the court, the power of advance and retreat taken over by a palace attendant and a courier of the imperial service, and a force half of them without armour pressing boldly forward: these three things were branded by the Censorate as provoking the fighting on the frontier; Pang Ji was demoted to governor of Qingzhou, and Sima Guang, though let off, was ashamed of his share of it, and a climate of caution about the use of force by frontier commanders grew up in the court, and the Linzhou line for the following years would defend and not attack. Economically, when soft and hard alike failed, the court could only fall back on the traditional economic sanction: a notice posted along the border stopping the markets of Shaanxi, while Mozang Epang on his side forbade the Xia to buy grain privately along the border, and such of the tribal households as broke the ban were beheaded on the spot with their wives and children removed for settlement in Huainan; the price of silk at the markets of the two frontiers rose to several thousand a bolt, and the complaints of officials and people on both sides were loud, and the pastoral and agricultural economy of Xia was badly hurt. This was one of the few weapons that really worked between the Song and the Xia. In international terms, this small defeat over a frontier fort was what finally forced the events of 1061, when the emperor Yizong put Mozang Epang to death, and June 1062, when the two states fixed the boundary posts and the rules of patrol; the dispute over the Quye river that had begun in 1055 was thereby closed, and the rule that the patrol parties of either side should not exceed thirty riders runs on as standard wording in the frontier documents of the Song and Xia down to this day. In technical terms, the battle laid bare the real weakness of the north-western frontier: the fort raised by moulded earth, the best thing the Song could build, was still no match for the envelopment of a purely mounted force operating over a long field of view, and the burning weapon in a copper tube that stands on the card, the head of the family of fire weapons, never once became a deciding factor on this frontier.
result: 結果是西夏勝、宋軍敗：宋軍在斷道塢的抵抗終告崩潰，營將郭恩見大軍已潰而自盡，走馬承奉黃道元與兵馬監押劉慶被俘，麟州知州武戡獨得脫身，所部死三百八十七人，兵甲器械散失一萬七千餘件。消息傳回京師，御史隨即彈劾河東經略使龐籍引惹邊事，龐籍為保司馬光而獨擔其責，貶知青州；司馬光連上書自請處分，力言敗因在邊將輕敵無備，朝廷駁其請而不加重處分。於是宋廷對西夏的政策再變，改用禁絕陝西緣邊和市與重新劃界對付，孫兆奉命與夏議界，卒以橫陽河為府州界而三分許一，只令夏人退還侵耕之田四十里。沒藏訹龐新得斷道塢之勝，更不肯退出侵耕地，仁宗下詔禁絕西人沿邊私糴民穀，蕃部犯禁者立斬，妻孥送淮南編管，界上一時風氣大緊。局面直到1061年李諒祚誅除沒藏訹龐、開始親政才轉機，同年宋方遣蘇安靜等再議界，1062年六月兩國正式定界，約定西界人戶不得過所築封堠東耕種、麟州界人戶不耕屈野河西，兩界巡捉各不得帶衣甲器械過三十人騎，違者捉送官並勒停和市。屈野河的界線糾紛至此平息，宋夏在這條邊界的爭端由兵戎轉為條款。
resultEn: The result was a Xia victory and a Song defeat. The Song stand at the Duandaowu broke down at last, the officer Guo En saw the army collapse and killed himself, the trotting courier of the imperial service Huang Daoyuan and the inspector of the cavalry Liu Qing were taken prisoner, and the governor of Linzhou Wu Kan escaped alone; three hundred and eighty-seven men of the Song were killed and seventeen thousand odd pieces of arms and armour were lost. When the news reached the capital the Censorate impeached the pacification commissioner for Hedong, Pang Ji, for provoking the fighting on the frontier; Pang Ji, to protect Sima Guang, took the whole blame and was demoted to governor of Qingzhou, and Sima Guang petitioned repeatedly to be punished, arguing that the defeat was due to the frontier commanders being light in enemy and unprepared; the court refused his request and added no further penalty. The Song policy towards Xia then changed again, and the answer to the Xia was now to stop the markets along the Shaanxi frontier and to redraw the boundary: Sun Zhao was sent to negotiate with the Xia, and it was settled that the Hengyang river should be the boundary of Fuzhou with one part in three given to the Xia, so that only some forty li of the encroached fields were given back. Having gained the victory at the Duandaowu, Mozang Epang was the less willing to give up the land his people had tilled, and the emperor issued an order forbidding the Xia to buy grain privately along the border, tribal households that broke the ban were beheaded on the spot and their wives and children sent for settlement in Huainan, and a tight air came over the frontier. The situation turned only in 1061, when Li Liangzuo put Mozang Epang to death and began to govern in his own person; in the same year the Song sent Su Anjing and others to negotiate the line again, and in June 1062 the two states formally fixed the boundary, agreeing that the households of the western side should not till beyond the boundary posts they had built, that the households of Linzhou should no longer till west of the Quye river, and that the patrols of either side should not go with more than thirty riders or with arms and armour, those who broke this being seized and sent to the officials and the markets stopped; the dispute over the Quye river was thereby closed, and the quarrel of the Song and Xia on this stretch of the frontier turned from arms into clauses.
